text: Economists across the spectrum prefer a tax to regulation because it lets each firm decide where abatement is cheapest, rather than having a rule-writer guess.
Every carbon tax passed so far has arrived with exemptions for the largest emitters, which is how a broad-based tax becomes a narrow one on households.
Kerbside composting diverts a third of landfill volume at trivial cost. Deliberately about a different motion, in the second pool.
